rows.label: bf02370100_0030
rows.name:
I can't let capturing an Iiran terrorist
become the disgrace of letting her escape.

rows.label: bf02370100_0040
rows.name:
That emerald Core Crystal...
You're Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf02370100_0050
rows.name:
It's infuriating, but...
Meleph was right after all.

rows.label: bf02370100_0060
rows.name:
You know about Homura?
Are you after her too?

rows.label: bf02370100_0080
rows.name:
Heaven's Holy Grail, whose power splits the sky
and the earth, is Alst's strongest Blade.

rows.label: bf02370100_0090
rows.name:
Only a fool who doesn't know its value
would fail to seek the Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf02370100_0110
rows.name: Therefore, I will obtain the Holy Grail...

rows.label: bf02370100_0130
rows.name: The logic jumps in the last step, mo.

rows.label: bf02370100_0140
rows.name:
Too bad - neither I nor Homura
are going to be your trophy.
